name: Glaxnimate
blurb: Glaxnimate is an open-source vector animation and motion design desktop application.
description:
Glaxnimate is an open-source vector animation and motion design desktop application.

Features:

• Tweening

• Precompositions

• Time Stretching

• Motion Along Path

• Shape Modifiers

• Text Support

• Animated Gradients

• Raster to Vector

• Scripting Support

Supported file formats:

• Lottie

• Animated SVG

• Animated WebP

• Animated Vector Drawables

• RIVE

• Video Export

• Spritesheet Export

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
